testcase.name: Scenario: Choose tabs-only mode and switches ribbon tabs: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:73:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Choose tabs-only mode and switches ribbon tabs ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part document is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full Tools ribbon is visible ✔ When the user opens the ribbon display control menu ✔ And the user chooses Minimize to Tabs ✔ Then the command groups are hidden and the ribbon tabs remain visible ✔ When the user selects the 3D Model tab ✔ Then its command groups appear temporarily below the tabs ✔ When the user clicks an empty area of the viewport ✔ Then the temporary command groups close ✔ And the 3D Model tab remains selected ✔ When the user opens the ribbon display control menu ✔ Then Minimize to Tabs is checked
